thread:
Marta: NovaHealth (customer_id: nova-984) flagged INV-20260730 — $12,400 in burst on top of their 6-GPU reserved commit. They say nothing changed on their side. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-20260730.pdf Can we look?

Eli: Pulling usage export: s3://billing-exports/nova-984/2026-07.csv. BILL-3368 opened to track.

ops-bot: Export ready  nova-984/2026-07.csv. Summary: total tokens 1.9B, burst tokens 260M, burst charges $12,400.

Sofia: CS says NovaHealth enforces strict routing through partner-provided gateway; they never send raw user tokens. Partner is MedPipe (partner_id: medp-9). Could be attribution issue.

Eli: Quick scan shows ~22% of burst rows have partner_header present but also a strange meter_tag "dup_emit_v2". I see repeated request_ids with increasing event_seq 1..3 within seconds. Looks like both duplication and partner-mapping mismatch.

Marta: If duplicates exist and partner mapping failed, they could be double-billed and for on-demand rates. Not good.

Eli: Action plan: 1) Deduplicate by request_id within 120s window and mark dup_emit_v2 rows nonbillable. 2) Re-attribute rows with partner header to partner commit pool when commit header missing. 3) Produce corrected usage and estimate credit. INF-7948 opened for emitter and router issues.

billing-bot: BILL-3368 created. INF-7948 created: investigate dup_emit_v2 and partner-header routing.

Sofia: Nova provided gateway logs showing single client requests and no duplicate retries. Support ticket #4870 attached.

Eli: Corrected export posted s3://billing-exports/nova-984/corrections/2026-07-dedup-reattrib.csv. Dedup removed 58.2M tokens. Re-attribution moved 41.4M tokens to partner reserved rate. Net on-demand differential removed = $11,820.

Marta: Recommend provisional full credit for the overage $11,820 plus $400 goodwill for partner friction = $12,220 while INF validates root cause. Approvers: @Marta (Finance), @Eli (Billing).

Eli: I approve. Applying provisional credit now and annotating invoice: "Provisional correction credit - under review".

billing-bot: BILL-3368 updated: provisional credit $12,220 applied to INV-20260730. Support ticket #4870 linked.

Sofia: Notifying customer: "We've applied a provisional credit of $12,220 while we reconcile duplicated emits and partner attribution. We'll follow up within 72 hours with final breakdown." Nova responded: "Thanks, we'll hold payment until resolved."

Eli: INF findings: dup_emit_v2 caused duplicate meter events during a brief emitter restart; gateway omitted commit header when retries hit fallback path. Root causes: emitter race condition and gateway fallback behavior. INF-7948 root cause documented.

Marta: Final reconciliation numbers?

Eli: Final differential confirmed = $11,820. Since provisional credit was $12,220, we over-applied by $400. Decision: keep provisional credit and classify extra $400 as goodwill. Final credit = $12,220. Approve final close.

Marta: Approved. Apply final credit $12,220 and close BILL-3368. Also ensure PM-1064 adds a billing precheck to detect partner-header omissions and INF task to fix emitter de-dup logic.

billing-bot: BILL-3368 closed. Final credit applied: $12,220 to INV-20260730. Artifacts: s3://billing-exports/nova-984/corrections/2026-07-dedup-reattrib.csv. Notifications sent to nova-984 and medp-9.

Sofia: Nova confirmed and resumed payment. Partnership team will follow up with MedPipe to patch gateway.

Marta: Thanks team. Closing thread and tagging PM-1064 for follow-up.
